snippet.title: Dimenshaper - Official Demo Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dimenshaper is a fast-paced precision platformer built around short, challenging levels and instant dimension switching. Jump, dash, wall-jump, and shift between dimensions to reveal new paths, avoid deadly obstacles, and reach the goal.

Master each mechanic, improve your times, and find the perfect route through every level. Simple controls, tight movement, and challenges designed to make you say: “One more try.”

🎮 Play the demo & wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5080950/Dimenshaper_Demo/

Developer: Barkhalla Studios

#indiegame #platformer #precisionplatformer #indiedev #steam #gamedev
